scope: Whole independently placed northern low roofed hall in the east forecourt of Unit 1. All four saved contemporary compiled corners, complete exterior walls and closed pitched roof. The two pale roofed halls are visible between the north cylindrical tank and the shore-side works in the already-cleared 1971 aerials. Current-to-historic footprint continuity and assignment of each roof to the current footprint are approximate; no intake/pump/process function asserted. Other hall, tanks, reactor, turbine building and whole plant remain separate.

quallaSearch.notes: Qualla-first: 25 source families and zero conflicts already screened. Used the same two cleared published DOE government-work originals only. Both original aerials personally inspected for these two separate low roofed halls. The east-west roof ridges, pale roof/wall finish and pair of low halls guide the exterior. Contemporary mapped corners retained; historical continuity, exact roof registration, heights, door/vent census and hidden details are estimates. No new source or accepted-model changes.

references.caption: Tokyo Electric Power Co., Fukushima Nuclear Power Station on the Pacific Ocean, 160 miles North of Tokyo, 1.2 square mile site. Japan.
